purpose: Single canonical experiment-state registry. Stores experiment structure, local/global purpose, mechanisms present/absent, falsification scope, outcome, target contribution, and dependency flow. Historical entries may have date-only timestamps when exact time has not yet been repo-verified; all new entries require exact UTC timestamps.

time_policy.new_records: RFC3339 UTC timestamp with seconds is mandatory for started_at_utc, closed_at_utc when known, and recorded_at_utc.
time_policy.historical_backfill: Never invent a clock time. Use date + time_precision=date_only until commit/workflow/prereg evidence verifies exact time.
time_policy.display_timezone: UTC canonical; local presentation may additionally show Europe/Istanbul.

records.local_question: Can the historical latent-only Geppetto family fit and retain the single Mage witness under its then-current serialization/optimizer regime?
records.global_purpose: Establish same-witness representational/capacity feasibility without claiming generated-skeleton-conditioned AR or generalization.
records.outcome_summary: Historical same-witness fit/retention evidence exists and materially established FIT1 capacity. Exact numerical/result artifact authority still needs canonical pointer backfill before reuse.
survived_or_supported: latent-only family has substantial same-witness FIT1 capacity
records.target_effect: Moved FIT1 from basic capacity uncertainty toward architecture/conditioning/stability diagnosis.
records.necessity_assessment: Useful historical capacity witness; not sufficient architecture closure.
records.index_note: Backfill exact sealed report/commit/run before quoting 53-check or other numerical details from this registry.

records.local_question: Does replacing the lossy raster-summary conditioning boundary with a lossless fixed 8-view evidence side path improve FIT1 reachability/stability while preserving historical trunk compatibility?
records.global_purpose: Repair a generic evidence-contract flaw before attributing failures to autoregression or optimizer behavior.
records.outcome_summary: Lossless evidence improved the representation contract and achieved reachability, but long-horizon terminal retention was not sufficient for architecture closure.
falsified_or_weakened: summary-only historical raster evidence is sufficient generic product authority
survived_or_supported: lossless evidence boundary is required architecture direction
cannot_prove: lossless side path alone solves Geppetto
records.target_effect: Moved the problem from evidence-loss diagnosis toward evidence-access and stability mechanisms.

records.local_question: Does giving every generation step direct access to the full lossless surface memory improve Mage FIT1 reachability/retention over pooled/lossless access?
records.global_purpose: Isolate evidence-access mechanism before changing locus generation or causal skeleton state.
records.outcome_summary: Full-surface access improved reachability/fit behavior but did not by itself close terminal long-horizon stability.
falsified_or_weakened: evidence access alone is the complete explanation for terminal instability
survived_or_supported: full-surface access is a useful generic evidence mechanism
records.target_effect: Reduced evidence-access uncertainty and justified isolating other mechanisms rather than redesigning the evidence seam again.

records.local_question: What changes when conditional diffusion is added as the continuous locus-generation mechanism on top of full-surface access?
records.global_purpose: Separate RigAnything-inspired locus generation from generated-skeleton causal feedback so later results can be attributed to one mechanism at a time.
records.outcome_summary: Component experiment lineage exists; exact normalized result pointer remains to be backfilled into the canonical registry before numerical reuse.
survived_or_supported: diffusion can be studied independently of skeleton feedback
records.target_effect: Preserved causal identifiability by preventing multiple RigAnything mechanisms from entering one unexplained bundle.
records.necessity_assessment: Methodologically useful isolation; final necessity unresolved here.

records.local_question: Does a preregistered optimizer-time cap on strong trunk actual updates prevent the catastrophic Mage FIT1 retention failures observed in the uncapped run?
records.global_purpose: Separate optimizer/trunk runaway from forward-architecture defects without smuggling a FIT1-specific containment mechanism into generic architecture claims.
records.outcome_summary: Containment strongly reduced catastrophic failures on Mage, but the preregistered strict 48/48 stability gate did not close; no post-hoc promotion is allowed.
falsified_or_weakened: all observed Mage retention failures must be forward-architecture failures
survived_or_supported: optimizer-time trunk runaway has a causal role on Mage
FIT1-specific containment can be scientifically legitimate when preregistered
records.target_effect: Clarified that some instability is optimizer-mediated, but did not remove the need to audit Geppetto architecture causality.
records.necessity_assessment: Useful diagnostic/containment mechanism; not a generic architecture answer.
records.index_note: Backfill exact prereg/result artifact pointer before numerical reuse.

records.local_question: What would a fuller RigAnything-mechanism Geppetto challenger look like when combining per-step surface access, diffusion locus, generated/teacher joint+parent feedback token, and sibling/BFS-order handling?
records.global_purpose: Preserve a formulation-level clean-room challenger so isolated component experiments do not erase knowledge of the complete reference mechanism family.
records.outcome_summary: Executable research challenger already exists. Source existence is not a scientific result; a complete authoritative C3/C4 run is not currently registered as closed.
survived_or_supported: RealSaS already translated the fuller RigAnything mechanism family into a research challenger
records.target_effect: Prevents repeated clean-room reimplementation and preserves the option of a formulation-level test after isolated mechanisms are understood.
records.necessity_assessment: Important preserved challenger; run only if the dependency graph makes it scientifically necessary.

records.local_question: With lossless evidence, full-surface policy, locus head, serialization, optimizer, seed/backend and free-running evaluation matched, does minimal joint+parent mechanical recurrent feedback improve FIT1 reachability/retention and structural prediction?
records.global_purpose: Isolate the generated-skeleton causal-state hypothesis from the rest of the RigAnything mechanism bundle before Geppetto architecture refreeze.
arms: AR1 = matched joint+parent mechanical feedback ON
mechanisms_present: joint+parent recurrent mechanical feedback only in AR1
records.outcome_summary: RUNNING. Interim AR0/AR1 traces are diagnostics only; no final outcome is authorized before both arms hit the preregistered fixed horizon and terminal gate is evaluated.
records.target_effect: If closed cleanly, removes one major architecture ambiguity before Geppetto refreeze regardless of which arm wins.

preregistered_outcome_logic.AR1_PASS_AR0_FAIL: minimal skeleton-causal feedback rescues this FIT1 configuration
preregistered_outcome_logic.AR0_PASS_AR1_PASS: minimal feedback is compatible but not necessary on this witness
preregistered_outcome_logic.AR0_PASS_AR1_FAIL: minimal feedback harms this FIT1 configuration
preregistered_outcome_logic.AR0_FAIL_AR1_FAIL: AR-01 does not close the architecture problem

records.local_question: Which Geppetto architecture/mechanism set is justified after AR-01 and any scientifically necessary formulation-level follow-up?
records.global_purpose: Freeze a generic/generalization-oriented Geppetto before moving the product-science bottleneck to Arachne.
records.target_effect: Unlocks Arachne FIT1 conditioning on a qualified Geppetto output contract.

records.local_question: Can Arachne learn usable editable skin/weight/deformation proposals from qualified IRIS+Geppetto outputs, with SkinTokens mechanisms clean-room audited and adapted only where needed?
records.global_purpose: Close the deformation layer required for an actual editable 2D puppet rather than a skeleton-only demo.
records.target_effect: Required to make Mage deform and visually breathe rather than merely possess a predicted skeleton.
records.necessity_assessment: Next major product-science module after Geppetto refreeze.

records.local_question: Can the compiled Mage puppet exhibit a convincing qualified idle/breath motion with editable rig/deformation while preserving 2D appearance?
records.global_purpose: Turn FIT1 scientific closure into the first emotionally legible RealSaS product proof: artwork -> inferred mechanics -> editable deformation -> motion.
records.target_effect: First end-to-end visible product milestone suitable for investor/demo communication while remaining scientifically scoped to one witness.
records.necessity_assessment: High-value product witness after FIT1 skeleton+deformation closure.

conditional_forks.condition: AR-01 result leaves formulation-level ambiguity scientifically material
conditional_forks.why: The fuller challenger already exists and should be run/adapted rather than reimplemented if AR-01's minimal intervention cannot answer the broader formulation question.

conditional_forks.condition: AR0 closes FIT1 and AR1 is unnecessary/harmful, with no remaining formulation question required for refreeze
conditional_forks.why: Do not add mechanisms merely because they exist in a reference model; preserve the simplest architecture supported by evidence while keeping the fuller challenger as research lineage.
